rca_of_issue: Bug: 'main' in /app/frontend/package.json was 'frontend/node_modules/expo-router/entry' — Node/Metro run cwd is /app/frontend, so the extra 'frontend/' segment made the path unresolvable, producing ConfigError at Expo startup. Fix: set 'main' to canonical 'expo-router/entry' (Expo Router auto-resolves node_modules). Verified by: fresh expo start with 0 ConfigError hits, HTTP 200 at /, and full UI+API regression through admin login.
